abstract: In addition to whole hCG, hCG beta-related molecular species are also present in the serum and urine of patients with trophoblastic diseases. We simultaneously measured whole hCG, free hCG beta and beta-core fragment in the serum and urine of patients with hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma by the highly specific and sensitive sandwich enzyme-immunoassay (EIA) systems using two kinds of antibodies. During the clinical courses of patients, although the whole hCG levels in serum and urine were closely correlated, the concentrations in the serum were almost twice as high as those in the urine. The free hCG beta levels were also closely correlated in serum and urine, but the concentrations of free hCG beta were extremely low as compared with those of whole hCG. Furthermore, free hCG beta/whole hCG ratios were significantly higher in choriocarcinoma patients than in hydatidiform mole patients. While whole hCG and free hCG beta were contained in both serum and urine, the beta-core fragment could be detected only in the urine of the patients. The relative contribution of the beta-core fragment to the total urinary hCG beta-immunoactivity accounted for about 40% in hydatidiform mole and about 70% in choriocarcinoma. We conclude that whole hCG should be measured in the serum rather than in the urine as a tumor marker for trophoblastic diseases, and suggest that the ratios of whole hCG, free hCG beta and beta-core fragment to each other may be useful indices to employ in the differential diagnosis of trophoblastic diseases.
abstract_ja: 胞状奇胎および絨毛癌の患者の血清および尿中には、全hCGに加え、hCGβ関連の分子種も存在する。二種類の抗体を用いた高特異度・高感度のサンドイッチ酵素免疫測定法により、全hCG、遊離hCGβ、βコア断片を血清と尿中で同時に測定した。患者の臨床経過中、血清と尿中の全hCG値は密接に相関したが、血清濃度は尿中の約2倍であった。遊離hCGβも血清と尿中で密接に相関していたが、全hCGに比べて濃度は極めて低かった。さらに、遊離hCGβ/全hCG比は、胞状奇胎患者よりも絨毛癌患者で有意に高かった。全hCGと遊離hCGβは血清と尿の両方に含まれていたが、βコア断片は患者の尿中のみで検出された。尿中のhCGβ免疫活性に占めるβコア断片の割合は、胞状奇胎で約40%、絨毛癌で約70%であった。絨毛性疾患の腫瘍マーカーとしては、全hCGを尿ではなく血清で測定すべきと結論する。また、全hCG、遊離hCGβ、βコア断片の相互の比率は、絨毛性疾患の鑑別診断に有用な指標となる可能性があると提案する。
